request.spec:
The sheet has notes: a text and an add button (NOTE_ADDED text=<text>; a blank note is refused with
an error beside the entry). Show the notes newest first as <sheet's today when added> <user>:
<text>. Under an as-of date the list shows the notes added while the sheet's today was on or before
that date.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has notes: a text and an add button (NOTE_ADDED text=<text>; a blank note is refused with
an error beside the entry). Show the notes newest first as <sheet's today when added> <user>:
<text>. Under an as-of date the list shows the notes added while the sheet's today was on or before
that date.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Sheet notes are in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec, including the "sheet notes" test and the audit lines it expects.

**Behaviour**
- Notes are listed newest first as `<date> <user>: <text>` (each line is a `note-line`). The date is the sheet's today when the note was added.
- Adding a note writes `NOTE_ADDED sheet=<id> by=<user> text=<text>`. When the user is acting under a delegation from a steward, the existing audit service adds `for=<steward>` at the end, as the test expects.
- A blank note is refused with `note-error` beside the entry. So is a note from a viewer or on an archived sheet, using the same checks as the other forms. A refused note stores nothing and writes nothing to the audit file.
- Under an as-of date, the list shows only notes whose stored date is on or before that date.
- The text is trimmed before it is stored.

**Changes**
- **Stored data:** a new table, `sheet_note`, in `src/main/resources/db/migration/V83__sheet_note.sql`. It holds the date added, the user and the text.
- **Server:** `GET` and `POST` on `/api/sheets/{sheetId}/notes`, defined in YAML next to the holidays endpoints. The Java code is in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/note/`.
- **Front end:** a new section in `src/main/frontend/features/notes/`, with the `note-text`, `note-add`, `note-error` and `note-line` test ids.

**Decision for you:** cloning a sheet does not copy its notes. The request didn't mention cloning, so I left the clone code unchanged; it's a small addition if you want notes to come across.
